Sus chords require root in bass; added Δ7sus2 and 9sus4; explicit highlighter voicings

Fixed: renderChordDisplay in ui.ts now branches on pitchClasses.length (deduped) instead of activeMidiSorted.length, so doubled/octaved notes no longer break the 1-note/2-note (interval) special cases. Lowest sounding note determines interval direction since pitchClasses[0] is the pitch class of the lowest active MIDI note. Added e2e/intervals.test.ts as a regression test.

Done in index.html: body now uses fixed sans-serif font-family and #222222 color; --font-family/--font-color applied only to #chordDisplay (and inherited by placeholder/chord-main/chord-roman/chord-alt) and to .note-label/.octave-label. .chord-alt uses color-mix(in srgb, var(--font-color) 55%, white) for a lighter secondary tint instead of a fixed gray. .chord-roman keeps its own fixed gray (not requested to theme). Verified via Playwright that other UI (menu button, status, settings) is unaffected.

Implemented: 5 number inputs in the settings panel (chordFontSizeInput/secondaryFontSizeInput/tertiaryFontSizeInput/noteFontSizeInput/octaveFontSizeInput), each with its own cookie and --font-size-* CSS variable, applied via applyFontSizes() in ui.ts. Covered by e2e/font-size.test.ts. Note label placement decided by user via clarifying question (its own control, not grouped with Chord/Tertiary/Octave).

Fixed in index.html: #chordDisplay's min-height is now a calc() expression built from the --font-size-chord/secondary/tertiary variables (each * its line-height + margin), so it always fits the current font settings' worst case instead of a hardcoded 110px. Also gave .chord-roman/.chord-alt explicit line-height:1.2 so the calc's coefficients are deterministic regardless of font family metrics (e.g. Real Book/cursive vs sans-serif). Verified with the exact repro (Real Book font, chord size 60, C-E-G-D-F-A) and added a regression test in e2e/layout.test.ts.

Fixed: renderChordDisplay always emits .chord-main/.chord-roman/.chord-alt; CSS gives each a fixed em height with nowrap; e2e/layout.test.ts now asserts the chord name's top as well as the keyboard's, stepping through C-E-G-D-F-A at Real Book/60.

Rebuilt glow as dedicated overlay layers for even, small halos with no paint-order clipping. Split gradient's shared second color into 5 independent per-role colors and dropped text gradient entirely. Verified with updated/new e2e tests and pixel-level screenshot inspection.
